exposure: A new universal intervention program with targeted elements for inhibited/withdrawn behaviors (as the subject of perception)
outcome: Perceptions of the acceptability of the intervention program's aims, structure, contents, activities, and materials
cohort: The study participants were 15 preschool teachers and 14 psychologists from Portugal.
finding: The aims, contents, activities, and materials of the new universal intervention program for inhibited behaviors were considered highly acceptable by Portuguese preschool teachers and psychologists, with only minor structural and delivery modifications recommended.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time through focus groups.
